title: AI Education
subtitle: The AI education canon — curated channels, most-watched first
description: A fixed corpus, not a feed algorithm. Seeded from Tristan Hume's YouTube tier list (the list behind TristanTube), extended with the established AI-education canon, and cross-checked against 0x_Osprey's tiered AI-education channel list (2026-11-07) — two squatted handles were caught and corrected against it. Per channel: the 30 most-watched videos; giant generalist channels (MIT OCW, Stanford Online, freeCodeCamp) are title-filtered to AI/ML topics. Every channel was identity-verified at build time.
